Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:11:1.hebrew: קבולי נמי לא מקבלת - עלך חסרון השמרים. א"כ, מה משתכר? הרי השכר כולו בשמרים:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:11:1.english: And you also will not accept - upon yourself the loss of the sediment. If so, what does [the seller] profit? Behold, the entire profit is in the sediment.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:11:2.hebrew: זבון וזבין תגרא איקרי - בתמיה, משל הוא לאמר לשוטה: לקח בדמים וחזור ומכור בלא שכר, ותיקרי תגר:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:11:2.english: Buy and sell, is he called a merchant? - [This is said] rhetorically; it is a proverb said to a fool: "Buy for money and resell without profit, and you will be called a merchant?"

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:12:1.hebrew: אחד הלוקח ואחד המפקיד לפקטים - לוקח ומפקיד אחד הן לענין פקטים, תורה אחת לשניהם:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:12:1.english: Both one who buys and one who deposits with regard to residue - A buyer and a depositor are one [and the same] with respect to residue; [there is] one law for both of them.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:12:2.english: Piktim - The waste of the pits that float on the surface of the oil.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:12:3.hebrew: לוקח מקבל פקטים - אם מכר לו שמן סתם, יקבל ממנו שמן עם פקטים:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:12:3.english: A buyer accepts residue - If he sold him oil without specification, he [must] accept from him oil with residue.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:13:1.english: They stated murky oil only for the seller - They stated [that] the loss of the oil's murkiness [is] only for the seller.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:13:2.hebrew: שהרי הלוקח מקבל עליו - לפחות ממאה לוגין לוג ומחצה מחמת שמרים, לפיכך צריך ליתן לו שמן מזוקק בלא פקטים:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:13:2.english: For the buyer accepts upon himself - to deduct from a hundred lugin a log and a half on account of sediment; therefore, [the seller] must give him refined oil without residue.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:14:1.hebrew: כי מדה דתשרי - כשער הדמים של תשרי, שהוא בזול, וסתם שמנים עכורים, וקיבל עליו פקטים:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:14:1.english: According to the measure of Tishrei - According to the price rate of Tishrei, when it is inexpensive, and ordinary oils are murky, and [the buyer] accepted upon himself the residue.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:14:2.hebrew: הא דשקל מיניה בניסן בשער של ניסן - ביוקר, דדרך כל השמנים להיות מזוקקין בניסן, והלוקח סתם והמוכר סתם אין מוכר אלא מזוקק:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:14:2.english: This [case] where he takes from him in Nisan at the price of Nisan - At a high price, for it is the way of all oils to be refined in Nisan, and [when] one buys without specification and one sells without specification, he sells only refined [oil].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:15:1.hebrew: לא יחדו לו הבעלים מקום - בבית שומר, לאמר לו "זויות זו השאילני":
Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:15:1.english: The owners did not designate a place for it - in the bailee's house, saying to him, "Lend me this corner."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:15:2.english: For his purposes - To use it.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:15:3.english: For its purposes - For it was in an exposed place and close to breaking.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:15:4.hebrew: אם משהניחה - שכילה תשמישו, הושיבה במקום משתמר, בין שטלטלה מתחלה לצורכה בין שטלטלה לצורכו, פטור. ובגמרא פריך: מאי שנא לא יחדו מיחדו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:15:4.english: If, after he replaced it - [Meaning] that he finished his use [of it] [and] set it down in a guarded place; whether he moved it initially for its [own] purposes [or] whether he moved it for his purposes, he is exempt. And in the Gemara it asks: What is the difference [between] "they did not designate" [and] "they designated"?

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:16:1.hebrew: מני - הא דקתני רישא, דאם משהניחה נשברה, אף על פי שלצורכו נטלה מתחלה, פטור — דאמר משהחזירה הרי היא ברשות הבעלים כבתחלה, ואינו עליה אלא כשומר חנם ופטור על אונסיה, ואף על פי שלא הודיע לבעלים לומר "נטלתיה והחזרתיה", הויא השבה — רבי ישמעאל היא כו':
Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:16:1.english: Whose [is it] - That which [the Mishnah] teaches in the first clause, that if after he set it down it broke, even though he originally took it for his own use, he is exempt — for [the Tanna] says [that] once he returned it, it is in the domain of the owner as at first, and he is [responsible] for it only as an unpaid bailee and is exempt for unavoidable accidents [that befall] it, and even though he did not inform the owner to say, "I took it and returned it," it is [considered a valid] return — it is [the opinion of] Rabbi Yishmael, etc.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:1:1.hebrew: דל תלתין ושיתא - כוזי בשיתא זוזי שקנאה, פשו תריסר:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:1:1.english: Subtract thirty-six - pitchers for the six zuzim [for which] he bought it, [and] twelve remain.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:1:2.hebrew: דל תמניא שתותי - של מ"ח, שדרך הוא לחסר בבליעת הקנקן, כדתנן: יוציא לו שתות ליין. פשו לו לשכרו ארבע:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:1:2.english: Subtract eight, one-sixth - of [the] forty-eight, for it is normal [for wine] to diminish through absorption by the jar, as we learned in the Mishnah: "He deducts for him one-sixth for wine." Four remain for him as his profit.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:2:1.english: But didn't Shmuel say: "One who profits" - [That is,] in things that are necessities of life.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:2:2.hebrew: אל ישתכר יותר על השתות - הא שתות ישתכר, ולמה לא ישתכר רב יהודה עד שתות:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:2:2.english: May not profit more than one-sixth - Thus, he may profit one-sixth; and why did Rav Yehuda not profit up to one-sixth?

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:3:1.hebrew: איכא גולפי ושמריא - משתכר הוא הקנקן והשמרים, שלקח הכל בו' זוז:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:3:1.english: There are the jugs and the sediment - He gains the jug and the sediment, as he bought everything for six zuz.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:3:2.hebrew: דמי ברזנייתא - שנותן דמים לחנווני למוכרן, ומוציאן ומכריז עליו בחוצות. כרזנייתא — לשון כרזא. לשון אחר: אומנות יש בנקיבת ברזא בחבית של חרס, וצריך ליתן שכר:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:3:2.english: Payment for barzanyata - That he gives money to a storekeeper to sell them, and [the storekeeper] takes them out and announces it in the streets; [with the reading] karzanyata, an expression of karza [proclamation]. Another explanation: There is a craft in boring a tap-hole [barza] in an earthenware barrel, and one must pay a fee [for it].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:4:1.hebrew: במזופפין - דכיון דישנים הם ונתבלעו בלעותם, תו לא בלעי:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:4:1.english: [With regard to casks] coated with pitch - For since they are old and have absorbed their [full] absorption, they no longer absorb.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:4:2.english: Once they are saturated, they are saturated - [It] no longer absorbs.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:5:1.english: When you will find [reason] to say - When you examine carefully and know the essence of the matter.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:5:2.hebrew: מותר לערב שמרים - המוכר שמן לחבירו סתם בעת שהוא מזוקק, ששקעו ושקטו שמריו, מותר לו לערב ולבלבל שמרים המשוקעות, שיחזרו ויתערבו ויצאו עם השמן בתוך המדה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:5:2.english: It is permitted to mix sediment - One who sells oil to his fellow without specification at a time when it is refined — [meaning] that its sediment has sunk and settled — is permitted to mix and stir up the settled sediment, so that it will again become mixed and come out with the oil within the measure.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:5:3.hebrew: אסור לערב שמרים - שבחזקת מזוקק לוקחו ממנו, וזה מקלקלו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:5:3.english: [It is] prohibited to mix sediment - For [the buyer] buys it from him on the assumption [that it is] refined, and this [seller] spoils it.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:6:1.hebrew: והיינו טעמא דמקבל עליו - לוקח לוג ומחצה שמרים, בשלא ערבו ונתנו לו מזוקק:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:6:1.english: And this is the reason that he accepts upon himself - [the] buyer [accepts] a log and a half of sediment, when [the seller] did not mix it and gave it to him strained.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:6:2.hebrew: דא"ל - מוכר, אי בעי לערובי כו':
Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:6:2.english: As he says to him - [The] seller [says to him]: "If I wished to mix, etc."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:7:1.hebrew: הוה מזדבן - כשהייתי מוכרו בחנות, היה נמכר שמרים עם השמן:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:7:1.english: [It] would have been sold - When I would sell it in the store, the sediment would be sold with the oil.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:7:2.hebrew: בבעה"ב עסקינן - שהלוקח בעל הבית הוא, ולקחו למאכל ביתו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:7:2.english: We are dealing with a homeowner - For the buyer is a homeowner, and he bought it for his household's food.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:8:1.english: Yoke [tzemed] - The yoke that is placed upon the two oxen and joins them together.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:9:1.hebrew: הדבר ידוע - שאין צמד נמכר במאתים זוז, אלא כמות שהוא עם הבקר מכרו לו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:9:1.english: The matter is well-known - That a yoke is not sold for two hundred zuz; rather, as it is, with the cattle, he sold it to him.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:9:2.hebrew: וחכמים אומרים אין הדמים ראיה - אע"ג דלא שוה כולי האי, אחולי אחליה לוקח זה יתר הדמים. ור"י לית ליה שיהא מוחל מן הסתם, אלא אם כן פירש:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 40b:9:2.english: And the Sages say: The money is not a proof - Even though it is not worth that much, this buyer waived the excess money. And Rabbi Yehuda does not hold that he waives [it] without specification, unless he explicitly stated [so].

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 40b:10:1.hebrew: לדברי חכמים אסור לערב - וא"ת: ונימא משום דאית ליה מחילה, ולעולם מותר לערב? וי"ל: דמתניתין נמי מיירי אפי' כשהשמן עדיין בעין, והתם אין שייך מחילה, כיון שיכול לתקן — כי יאמר לו: "קח השמרים וערב בשמן". ולרב פפא, דאמר דטעמייהו משום מחילה — סבר דהשמן אינו בעין, דאילו הוה בעין לא שייך ביה מחילה; אי נמי, סבר דאף ע"פ שהוא בעין שייך ביה מחילה, כיון דמדדו מזוקק:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 40b:10:1.english: According to the statement of the Rabbis, it is prohibited to mix [sediment] - And if you ask: why not say [that the reason is] because there is waiver, and in fact it is permitted to mix [sediment]? One can answer: our Mishnah also deals even with [a case] where the oil is still extant, and there waiver does not apply, since he can rectify [it] — for he can say to him, "Take the sediment and mix [it] into the oil." And according to Rav Pappa, who said that their reason is because of waiver — he holds that the oil is not extant, for if it were extant, waiver would not apply to it; alternatively, he holds that even though it is extant, waiver applies to it, since he measured it out refined.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 40b:11:1.hebrew: לדברי ר"י אסור - וא"ת: ולימא מותר, וטעמא דמקבל משום דלית ליה מחילה? וי"ל: דרב פפא סבר דצמד ובקר איכא הוכחה דלאו מחילה, דמסתמא לא רצה ליתן מאתים זוז על הצמד בלא בקר; אבל הכא, לוג ומחצה שהוא דבר מועט, מדלא עירב — אחולי אחיל:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 40b:11:1.english: According to the statement of Rabbi Yehuda, [it is] prohibited - And if you ask: Let [Rav Pappa] say [that according to Rabbi Yehuda it is] permitted, and the reason that [the buyer] accepts [the deduction] is because [Rabbi Yehuda] does not hold of [the principle of] renunciation? One can answer: Rav Pappa holds that [in the case of] a yoke and oxen there is proof that it is not renunciation, since presumably one would not want to pay two hundred zuz for the yoke without the oxen; whereas here, [in the case of] a log and a half, which is a small amount, since he did not mix [it], he certainly renounced [it].

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 40b:11:2.hebrew: זבון וזבין תגרא איקרי - מיירי שלא היה מוצא למכור ביוקר יותר משלקחו, לכך א"ל: אדעתא דהכי קנית ממני, שהיית יודע שאעכב לוג ומחצה כדי שארויח קצת:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 40b:11:2.english: "[One who] buys and sells — is he called a merchant?" - [The Gemara] is referring to a case where [the seller] could not find [anyone] to sell [it] to at a higher price than what he bought it for; therefore he says to him: "On this understanding you bought [it] from me, that you knew I would withhold a log and a half so that I would profit a little."

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 40b:13:1.hebrew: לא אמרו שמן עכור אלא למוכר - פי': לא אמרו הפסד של עכירת פקטים אלא למוכר, דכשנותן ללוקח שמן מזוקק אינו מחסר לו כלום ממאה לוג בשביל הפקטים, כי אם לוג ומחצה בשביל השמרים. מיהו עכירה לא שייכא כל כך בפקטים, אלא בדבר המתערב כמו שמרים. וי"ל דלא אמרינן הפסד של עכירת השמרים אלא למוכר: שאם מוכר כשהוא מזוקק, מקבל עליו לוקח בשביל השמרים לוג ומחצה והמוכר מרויח השמרים; וכשהוא מוכר שמן עכור, נותן מאה לוגין שלמים שמן עכור ומפסיד השמרים ע"י מה שמכר כשהוא עכור. וכשמוכר מזוקק לא קרי הפסד לוקח אע"פ שמפסיד שמרים, משום דבעה"ב ניחא ליה בצילא:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 40b:13:1.english: "They stated [that] murky oil is only for the seller" - Explanation: They stated [that] the loss from the murkiness of the residue [falls] only upon the seller, for when he gives the buyer refined oil, he does not deduct anything for him from the hundred log on account of the residue, but only a log and a half on account of the sediment. However, "murkiness" does not apply so much to residue, but rather to something that mixes in, such as sediment. And one can say that we only say [that] the loss from the murkiness of the sediment [falls] upon the seller: for if he sells [the oil] when it is refined, the buyer accepts upon himself [a deduction of] a log and a half for the sediment and the seller gains the sediment; whereas when he sells murky oil, he gives a full hundred log of murky oil and loses the sediment because he sold it while it was murky. And when he sells [it] refined, it is not called a loss for the buyer even though he loses the sediment, because a householder prefers clear [oil].

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 40b:2:1.hebrew: אל ישתכר יותר על שתות - הא עד שתות משתכר, ומסתמא רב יהודה היה מוצא שיתנו לו יותר; ולמה הניח מלהרויח עד שתות:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 40b:2:1.english: May not profit more than one-sixth - Implying [that] up to one-sixth one may profit, and presumably Rav Yehuda could have found [buyers] who would give him more; so why did he refrain from profiting up to one-sixth?

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 40b:4:1.hebrew: במזופפין שנו - וא"ת: כל שכן דבלע טפי, כדאמרינן לעיל: "באתרא דמר חפו בכופרא דמייץ טפי"? וי"ל: דהיינו חדש, אבל ישן שכבר בלע — אינו בולע יותר. אי נמי: התם ביין, אבל הכא בשמן לא בלע, כיון שהוא ישן:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 40b:4:1.english: [They] taught [the mishna] with regard to [casks] coated with pitch - And if you will say: All the more so that it absorbs more, as we said above: "In the Master's place they coat [casks] with pitch, which absorbs more"? One can answer: That [applies to] a new [cask], but an old [cask] that has already absorbed [oil] does not absorb any more. Alternatively: there [it was referring] to wine, whereas here with oil it does not absorb [more], since it is old.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 40b:7:1.hebrew: לחודיה לא מזדבן - וא"ת: ויתן לו מוכר ללוקח לוג ומחצה שמרים שיערב עדיין וימכור? וי"ל: דמיירי מתני' אפי' אין השמן בעין, שלקחו מעט מעט ומכרו או אכלו:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 40b:7:1.english: It cannot be sold on its own - And if you should ask: Let the seller give the buyer a log and a half of sediment so that he can still mix [it in] and sell [it]? One can answer that the Mishnah is referring [to a case] even where the oil is no longer on hand, for he took it little by little and sold it or consumed it.
